user.title: Connect a VOGE account
user.description: Sign in with your VOGE account by default, or choose the advanced token-only mode.

credentials.title: Enter VOGE credentials
credentials.description: Password login is used only for the read-only vehicle API. The password is stored in Home Assistant local configuration so expired tokens can be renewed automatically.

vehicle.title: Select the motorcycle
vehicle.description: Selection is local only. The integration will not change the server-side default motorcycle.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate VOGE
reauth_confirm.description: Enter replacement VOGE credentials for the same motorcycle. Password login renews expired tokens automatically.

error.invalid_auth: The VOGE credentials are invalid or the token could not be renewed.
error.cannot_connect: Could not read the VOGE cloud vehicle list.
error.vehicle_missing: The selected motorcycle is no longer in the validated response.
error.target_vehicle_missing: The replacement token does not have access to the configured motorcycle.

abort.already_configured: This VOGE account is already configured.
abort.setup_state_missing: The setup state expired. Start setup again.
abort.reauth_entry_missing: The config entry for reauthentication no longer exists.

init.title: VOGE options
init.description: Polling remains read-only. The server timezone is a provisional assumption for timestamps without an offset.

error.invalid_timezone: Enter a valid IANA timezone, such as Asia/Shanghai.

get_month_trips.name: Get monthly trips
get_month_trips.description: Return daily and individual trip summaries for the configured motorcycle.

get_route_geojson.name: Get route GeoJSON
get_route_geojson.description: Return one verified route as a GeoJSON LineString.

get_day_geojson.name: Get daily GeoJSON
get_day_geojson.description: Return each verified trip for one server-provided day as a separate GeoJSON feature.
